BoldReports._AdminPassword_comment: REQUIRED via BOLD_REPORTS_PASSWORD env var in non-Development environments
BoldReports._EmbedSecret_comment: REQUIRED via BOLD_REPORTS_SECRET env var in non-Development environments

BoldBI._AdminPassword_comment: REQUIRED via BOLD_BI_PASSWORD env var in non-Development environments
BoldBI._EmbedSecret_comment: REQUIRED via BOLD_BI_SECRET env var in non-Development environments (distinct from BoldReports)

Jwt._comment: Set Jwt:Authority to the Keycloak realm metadata URL to enable JWKS validation. When unset, [Authorize] still requires a Bearer token but the controller decodes claims without signature verification (acceptable only in Development).
